marco (product): Heads-up: SOC customers want a compact observability surface that directly ties cost to error/latency per deployment. We need a decision on what lands in the Q2 MVP.
tara (eng-obs): Goal: ship something that proves the value quickly. Suggestion: 4 widgets only — cost trend (by route), error-rate (by model+version), p99 latency heatmap, and a small span-hotspots list with counts. No fancy compare view in MVP.
kevin (sre): Must include automatic alert templates and an \"open incident draft\" action in UI. Otherwise ops can't act. Also retention: keep trace->request_id mapping 48h for incident repro.
anya (data): Cost tradeoffs: high-cardinality tags (customer_id + route + model_version) explode series. For MVP do pre-aggregated rollups: per-hour route+model, per-minute route-only. Full cardinality is Q3.
leo (solutions): Customers asked for a lightweight \"compare\" that doesn't need full-cardinality: side-by-side deltas for a selected time window and a pinned customer. That could be a beta flag rather than core.
tara (eng-obs): On sampling — two levers: sample rate and event-preserve for errors (always keep error traces). Config idea:
```
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.05
  preserve_errors: true
  overrides:
    vip_customers: 1.0
    critical_route: 0.25
```
This reduces join loss while keeping hotspot accuracy for errors.
kevin (sre): Acceptance gating suggestion: require no regression > 5% p95/p99 on baseline for 7-day canary, and ensure incident draft creation works end-to-end during the canary.
marco (product): Let's be explicit about launch criteria (MVP vs Beta):
MVP (Q2 beta):
- 4 widgets: cost trend, error-rate, p99 heatmap, span-hotspots (sampled)
- Sampling policy implemented & documented
- Alert templates + incident draft action
- Retention: 48h join window for traces
- Canary rollout to 5% traffic; run 7-day stability check
Beta (opt-in):
- Pinned-customer compare UI (pre/post delta)
- Hourly raw-trace viewer for pinned customers (1h window)
- Full-sample option for Dedicated customers
anya (data): Metrics/storage estimate for MVP: roughly 120k series/month with 48h join. Beta compare adds ~40% more depending on number of pinned customers. Need pricing note.
leo (solutions): We'll need a templated customer playbook for onboarding: feature toggle, expected noise from sampling, how to request full-sample, and what to expect in cost delta.
tara (eng-obs): Implementation notes: backend exposes aggregated endpoints: /api/obs/cost-by-route, /api/obs/error-by-model, /api/obs/span-hotspots. Span-hotspots returns top N spans with p95/p99 and sample_count. UI shows delta_vs_baseline badging.
kevin (sre): Runbook items: how to escalate from incident draft, how to extract raw traces for a customer (if full-sample enabled), and a rollback checklist for the canary. Include automated smoke test that fires a known latency span and verifies it surfaces in hotspots.
marco (product): Prioritization: Tara, can you rough-sprint-breakdown for MVP? Anya, finish cost estimate and retention pricing by Thursday. Leo, collect the three customers asking for compare by EOD. Kevin, draft runbook skeleton. I'll set a decision meeting Friday afternoon.
ci-bot: Meeting created: \"Obs MVP scope decision\" — Fri 3:00pm. :calendar:
